key.name: jira-url
key.description: The URL of your Jira instance (e.g., https://company.atlassian.net)

key.name: jira-auth
key.description: Base64 encoded "email:apiToken" credentials for Jira Cloud, or a personal access token for Jira Data Center and Server

key.name: server-type
key.description: Selects both the REST endpoint and the credential format, because the two are tied together: Jira Cloud uses REST API v3 at /rest/api/3/search/jql with Basic auth, while Jira Data Center and Server only serve /rest/api/2/search and require a Bearer personal access token

key.name: webhook-url
key.description: Optional webhook URL to call when new tasks are found
